properties.text: First deposit to empty reserve must not allow exchange rate manipulation via donation attack.
properties.assertion: forall deposit(amt) when total_supply == 0: minted_ctokens == amt (exchange_rate = 1.0, no inflation possible)

properties.text: Exchange rate must not decrease due to direct underlying token donation to reserve.
properties.assertion: forall t1 < t2: exchange_rate(t2) >= exchange_rate(t1) absent liquidation revenue

properties.text: cToken mint amount must round down (against depositor) to prevent exchange rate dilution.
properties.assertion: forall mint(amt): minted_ctokens == floor(amt / exchange_rate), never ceil

properties.text: cToken burn/redeem must round down (against withdrawer) to prevent reserve drain.
properties.assertion: forall burn(ct): redeemed_underlying == floor(ct * exchange_rate), never ceil

properties.text: Reserve accounting: cash + debt - cash_reserve must equal total depositor value at all times.
properties.assertion: forall op: exchange_rate * total_supply == cash + debt - cash_reserve

properties.text: Cash must always be >= cash_reserve to prevent borrowing protocol revenue.
properties.assertion: forall state: reserve.cash >= reserve.cash_reserve.ceil()

properties.text: Borrow index must be monotonically non-decreasing across all interest accruals.
properties.assertion: forall accrue(t1, t2) where t1 < t2: borrow_index(t2) >= borrow_index(t1)

properties.text: repay_fee_rate must be used as reserve_factor (protocol revenue share), not as a repay fee.
properties.assertion: accrue_interest: cash_reserve += reserve_factor * interest_accumulated (not repay_fee * repay_amount)

properties.text: Interest rate model must be continuous at kink points with no discontinuity.
properties.assertion: calc_interest(mid_kink) from low segment == calc_interest(mid_kink) from mid segment

properties.text: Utilization rate must stay in [0, 1] range; util > 1 indicates accounting error.
properties.assertion: forall state: 0 <= util_rate(reserve) <= 1.0

properties.text: Interest must be accrued before any borrow operation to prevent stale index exploitation.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(obl, amt): accrue_interest(reserve, now) called before try_borrow_asset()

properties.text: Interest must be accrued before repay to ensure correct debt calculation.
properties.assertion: forall repay(obl, amt): accrue_interest(reserve, now) called before repay_debt()

properties.text: All obligation debts and collaterals must have interest refreshed before liquidation safety check.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(obl): refresh_obligation_assets_interest(all) called before ensure_liquidate_allowed

properties.text: Obligation safety check must use fresh oracle prices, not cached or stale values.
properties.assertion: forall safety_check(obl): oracle.get_price(clock) uses current clock, price freshness validated

properties.text: Obligation must belong to the target market for all lending operations.
properties.assertion: forall op(obl, market): obligation.market_id() == market.id

properties.text: Obligation must remain safe (weighted_debt <= weighted_collateral) after borrow.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(obl, amt): post(weighted_debts_value(obl) <= weighted_collateral_value(obl))

properties.text: Obligation must remain safe after withdrawal of collateral.
properties.assertion: forall withdraw(obl, ct): post(weighted_debts_value(obl) <= weighted_collateral_value(obl))

properties.text: Debt must be >= min_borrow_amount or exactly zero after borrow or repay (no dust debt).
properties.assertion: forall borrow_or_repay(obl, type): post(debt(type) >= min_borrow || debt(type) == 0)

properties.text: Flash loan repay must return exactly borrowed amount + fee; no partial repayment allowed.
properties.assertion: forall repay_flash_loan(coin, loan): coin.value() == loan.amount + loan.fee

properties.text: Flash loan fee must be non-zero to prevent free flash loans draining protocol revenue.
properties.assertion: forall borrow_flash_loan(amt): fee = flash_loan_fee_rate * amt > 0, abort if fee == 0

properties.text: Flash loan hot potato must prevent re-entrancy; only one flash loan active per market at a time.
properties.assertion: forall borrow_flash_loan: pre(!flash_loan_ongoing) && post(flash_loan_ongoing)

properties.text: An asset cannot be simultaneously used as collateral and borrowed in the same obligation.
properties.assertion: forall obl, type: !(ctokens.contains(type) && debts.contains(type))

properties.text: Liquidation must only proceed when obligation is unsafe (weighted_debts > weighted_collateral).
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(obl): pre(weighted_debts_value(obl) > weighted_collateral_value(obl))

properties.text: Liquidation close_factor must limit repay amount unless position is near bad debt.
properties.assertion: if collateral > 1.01 * debts: repay_amount <= close_factor * total_debt; bypass only near bad debt

properties.text: Seized cTokens in liquidation must not exceed obligation's total cToken balance for that collateral.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(obl, coll): seized_ctokens <= obligation.ctoken_balance(coll_type)

properties.text: Liquidation revenue factor portion must go to protocol reserve, not liquidator.
properties.assertion: liquidate: protocol_seize == revenue_factor * redeem_amount; added to cash_reserve

properties.text: Liquidation seize calculation must use correct formula with oracle prices and exchange rate.
properties.assertion: seized_ct = (repay * (1 + incentive) * price_debt) / (price_collateral * exchange_rate)

properties.text: Rate limiter outflow sum across all segments in a cycle must not exceed outflow_limit.
properties.assertion: forall op: sum(segments[i].value for i in cycle) + new_value <= outflow_limit

properties.text: Rate limiter reduce_outflow must only affect current segment, not historical segments.
properties.assertion: reduce_outflow(now, val): only segments[(now / seg_duration) % n].value reduced

properties.text: ADL liquidation_ltv must decrease hourly to progressively allow more liquidations.
properties.assertion: adl_ltv(t2) <= adl_ltv(t1) for t2 > t1 (monotonically decreasing via saturating_sub)

properties.text: ADL liquidation incentive must be capped by normal liquidation_incentive to prevent excess seizure.
properties.assertion: adl_incentive(t) <= normal_liquidation_incentive for all t

properties.text: Flash loan must not alter reserve cash or debt accounting fields (temporary withdrawal only).
properties.assertion: borrow_flash_loan: reserve.cash unchanged, reserve.debt unchanged; only underlying_balance affected

properties.text: Permission bitmask check must validate both whitelist membership and specific permission bit.
properties.assertion: ensure_has_permission(cap, what): whitelist.contains(cap.id) && (permission & (1 << what)) != 0

properties.text: Market validation must check both MarketType registration and object ID to prevent spoofing.
properties.assertion: validate_market: markets.contains(T) && markets[T] == object::id(market)

properties.text: Oracle price feeds must be fresh and within acceptable confidence interval.
properties.assertion: forall price_query(oracle, clock): price.timestamp >= clock.now - max_staleness

properties.text: Pyth oracle confidence interval must be checked to reject unreliable price data.
properties.assertion: forall pyth_price(feed): price.confidence / price.price <= max_confidence_ratio

properties.text: Obligation owner capability must be required for deposit, borrow, withdraw, and claim operations.
properties.assertion: forall op in {deposit, borrow, withdraw, claim}: caller owns ObligationOwnerCap matching obligation

properties.text: Flash loan within same PTB must not manipulate exchange rate to profit from deposit/withdraw.
properties.assertion: flash_loan borrow/repay must not affect exchange_rate used in concurrent mint/burn in same tx

properties.text: Flash loan must not be usable to bypass obligation safety check via temporary liquidity injection.
properties.assertion: flash_loan lock prevents borrow/withdraw during active flash loan in same market

properties.text: Self-liquidation must not be profitable: liquidator cannot liquidate own obligation for net gain.
properties.assertion: forall self_liq(user): value(seized_collateral) - value(repaid_debt) <= 0 for self-liquidation

properties.text: Deposit amount must not breach per-asset max_deposit_amount limit.
properties.assertion: forall deposit(amt, asset): total_deposits(asset) + amt <= asset.max_deposit_amount

properties.text: Total borrow must not exceed per-asset max_borrow_amount ceiling.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(amt, asset): reserve.debt.ceil() <= asset.max_borrow_amount

properties.text: Emode group total borrow must not exceed emode_max_borrow limit.
properties.assertion: forall borrow(amt, emode): emode_total_borrow + amt <= emode_max_borrow

properties.text: Emode group borrow amount must be updated on both borrow and repay operations.
properties.assertion: forall borrow/repay: emode_group.update_asset_borrow(old_amount, new_amount) called

properties.text: Overpayment in repay must be returned as refund, not absorbed by protocol.
properties.assertion: forall repay(obl, coin): if coin.value() > debt.ceil(): refund = coin.value() - debt.ceil()

properties.text: Debt interest accrual must use ratio of new_index/old_index, not absolute difference.
properties.assertion: debt.accrue: new_amount = amount * new_borrow_index / old_borrow_index

properties.text: Simple interest factor must use exact elapsed time, not rounded to nearest block/epoch.
properties.assertion: simple_interest_factor = interest_rate * (now - last_updated), where now = clock_ms / 1000

properties.text: Zero-debt entries must be removed from obligation after full repay to prevent ghost positions.
properties.assertion: forall repay(obl, type): if debt(type) == 0: debts.remove(type)

properties.text: Reward claim must only be executable by obligation owner via obligation_owner_cap.
properties.assertion: forall claim_reward(obl): caller owns ObligationOwnerCap where cap.id matches obligation

properties.text: Reward index must be updated before claiming to prevent stale reward calculation.
properties.assertion: forall claim_reward: reward_manager.update_index(shares, clock) before claim(obligation_id)

properties.text: ADL borrow deleverage must require total debt to breach target_amount before activation.
properties.assertion: forall adl_borrow_liq: total_borrow(type) > adl_target_amount(type)

properties.text: ADL collateral deleverage must require total deposit to breach target_amount before activation.
properties.assertion: forall adl_deposit_liq: total_deposit(type) > adl_target_amount(type)

properties.text: Version check must be enforced on all entry point functions to prevent stale contract calls.
properties.assertion: forall entry_point: ensure_version_matches() called before any state mutation

properties.text: Circuit breaker must prevent all lending operations when triggered for a market.
properties.assertion: forall op when circuit_break(market): op aborts with market_under_circuit_break

properties.text: Rate limiter deposit reduce_outflow on deposit must correctly offset prior add_outflow on withdraw.
properties.assertion: deposit: emode.deposit_limiter.reduce_outflow(now, amount) reduces current segment value

properties.text: Deposit and borrow rate limiters must use separate outflow tracking to prevent cross-limit bypass.
properties.assertion: emode.deposit_limiter != emode.borrow_limiter (separate state objects)

properties.text: Reserve repay overpayment (repay > total debt) excess must go to cash_reserve, not vanish.
properties.assertion: if repay_amount > debt: cash_reserve += (repay_amount - debt.ceil()); debt = 0

properties.text: Obligation interest refresh must cover ALL debt types and collateral types before safety check.
properties.assertion: refresh_obligation_assets_interest iterates all debts and all collaterals, not just target type

properties.text: Each obligation must belong to exactly one market; cross-market obligation sharing must be impossible.
properties.assertion: forall obl: obl.market_id() is set once at creation and never changes

properties.text: Emode group must exist in registry before obligation creation to prevent phantom group references.
properties.assertion: forall enter_market(emode): assert_emode_group_exists(emode) before obligation::new()

properties.text: Liquidation with zero repay amount must be rejected to prevent zero-amount griefing.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate: assert available_repay_coin.value() != 0

properties.text: Collateral asset must have can_be_collateral flag set to true for liquidation seize.
properties.assertion: forall liquidate(coll_type): asset_config(coll_type).can_be_collateral == true

properties.text: ADL liquidation_revenue_factor must be zero to not extract protocol revenue during auto-deleverage.
properties.assertion: forall adl_liquidate: liquidation_revenue_factor == 0
